applied_principles: preserve causal history rather than static convenience labels
do not turn runtime representation into hidden human essence

authority.jurisdiction: Minimum universal generation/development base state; ADP-008-owned optional versioned phase-segment registry; boundary/admission semantics; actor-local phase membership; effective-time/replay/provenance; read-only resolver, genealogy and scheduler interfaces.
not_owned: actor psychology, maturity, personality, Enneagram or attractor state
hybrid scheduler precedence or slow-process cadence
V2 phenomenology, expression, transcript or life-season semantics

historical_archive.authority_limit: Recovered V3/V2/server material is continuity/authority-recovery evidence only; historical V5/DDM has zero authority over current V550+.

universal_phase_vocabulary.semantic: A governed prospective-generation subject may be referenced for generation/context planning, but no V3 actor activation has established active actor causal history.
universal_phase_vocabulary.semantic_ceiling: No living-person biography, age, parent/caregiver/household, position, identity, personality, maturity or developmental-segment assertion.

universal_phase_vocabulary.semantic: A governed V3 actor has been activated and is in open-ended developmental causality.
universal_phase_vocabulary.semantic_ceiling: No finer age/life-course segment, maturity, adulthood, autonomy, legal status, school/work/family role, personality, Enneagram or attractor assertion.

universal_base_transition.required_input: governed actor activation/birth-generation event or receipt
universal_base_transition.ownership_law: ADP-007 owns whether/how actor activation occurs; ADP-008 owns only the resulting phase-state consequence.

active_unsegmented_representation.meaning: lawful active development with no finer governed segmentation

phase_registry.new_segment_creation_law: A new phase segment requires a new accepted ADP-008 registry version or accepted amendment under the same named authority. Code, config, scheduler, resolver, age table or consumer convenience cannot create it.
segment_definition_requirements: mutual-exclusion/coexistence semantics where needed inside that rule namespace

example_input_owners.ADP-009: generated position/mobility facts if an ADP-008 rule explicitly declares them
example_input_owners.ADP-010: generated opportunity/encounter/exposure facts if explicitly declared
example_input_owners.ADP-015: generated relationship/household/genealogy facts if explicitly declared
example_input_owners.other_accepted_v3_rule_authority: its own generated causal event/fact or versioned derived predicate if explicitly named

runtime_evaluation_record.semantic_status: runtime receipt executing ADP-008 registry authority, not a separate semantic authority

optional_segment_admission_requirements: phase_rule_id@version exists in the active ADP-008 registry
segment/transition identity exists in that rule
all required inputs come from exact authorities/classes declared by the rule
boundary predicate evaluates deterministically under exact version
no forbidden inference, ambiguity or integrity failure exists
versioned phase transition/membership record is committed at effective_time
allowed_boundary_ingredients_when_explic: chronological age or elapsed actor time
lawful versioned derived predicates with causal inputs reachable

age_time_may: be consumed directly by another governed V3 rule within that rule's jurisdiction
serve as an explicit phase boundary guard or complete boundary basis when an ADP-008 registry entry explicitly defines it
yield a scheduler trigger time when an accepted registry rule makes a future boundary deterministically knowable
age_time_may_not: select a human developmental phase through an implicit if-age-then-phase table
revive recovered lifecycle slots as aliases
imply maturity, autonomy, legal status, personality, ideology, family role, school/work position, attractor state or biography
age_time_law.semantic_ceiling: Age/time supplies chronology/eligibility only beyond whatever narrow phase-segment meaning the exact registered rule explicitly authorizes.

decision_states.meaning: Base phase verified; actor is active-unsegmented or has exact governed segment memberships.
Universal activation or registered segment transition passed exact rule/integrity checks and committed.
Relevant base phase or already-governed required membership cannot be lawfully established.
Consumer requests a finer distinction absent from the active ADP-008 registry; no substitute is invented.
Governed segment rule exists but a required boundary input is not yet bound/known; current lawful phase remains.
Incompatible same-time candidates survive under one governing rule with no lawful resolution.
Requested base/segment transition is not admitted by the exact rule.
Forbidden structural/demographic/legacy/V2/personality/type material is offered as phase semantics/authority.

effective_time_law.base_activation: Governed actor activation at T ends generation-pending and establishes V3DP_DEVELOPMENT_ACTIVE at T.
effective_time_law.optional_segments: Membership intervals or event-indexed states are defined only by the exact registered phase rule.

payload: relevant active governed phase segment refs if any
resolver_may: use verified base/segment refs as explicit predicate inputs
continue phase-independent resolution while optional segmentation is absent
defer phase-required objects when exact governed membership is unresolved
resolver_may_not: infer phase from age or query purpose
infer phase from geography, structural priors, prevalence or demographics

required_identity: age/time source and chronology version when used
named RNG provenance only if an input-producing authority lawfully used randomness
repository/resolver receipts only when explicitly used as context

authority_and_interface_consumers: ADP-009 generated position/transition/mobility rules where explicitly consuming a governed phase ref
ADP-010 encounter/opportunity/exposure rules where explicitly consuming a governed phase ref
later V3 age/development-gated rules explicitly naming chronology or an exact governed ADP-008 segment

hostile_fixtures.expected: remain V3DP_DEVELOPMENT_ACTIVE unsegmented; PHASE_SEGMENT_NOT_GOVERNED if finer distinction requested

age known but base-phase history invalid
structural/demographic adult/adolescent label offered
V2 burnout_phase offered
annual tick with no registered phase rule
registered age-only segment rule with satisfied exact guard

hostile_fixtures.case: same age threshold without registered rule
registered event/fact-based rule missing required input
two incompatible same-time transitions under one rule
child phase copied from parent/household/cohort
resolver Phase A/B supplied as developmental phase
scheduler mutates phase from trigger without ADP-008 evaluation
hostile_fixtures.expected: reject; trigger is not phase authority

hostile_fixtures.case: checkpoint segment absent from referenced registry version
new registry version silently reclassifies prior years
hostile_fixtures.expected: reject in-place rewrite; explicit replay/migration required

consumer invents ad hoc phase string to fill non-null field
named authority supplies generated fact to registered phase rule
hostile_fixtures.expected: fact may be consumed; phase meaning remains ADP-008-owned

hostile_fixtures.case: derived predicate lacks rule/version or reachable causal parents
exact duplicate transition ID/hash appears twice
hostile_fixtures.expected: safe deduplication; no duplicate causal change

consumer_release_sufficiency.scope: MUST-008 is closed by minimum universal state plus ADP-008-owned optional registry; no unnamed semantic authority is required.
consumer_release_sufficiency.future_ungoverned_phase_request: PHASE_SEGMENT_NOT_GOVERNED is correct fail-closed operation, not failure of MUST-008.
